Looking at the error, I need to identify what's causing the incorrect result. Based on the programming model requirements and the code analysis, there are several issues:

1. The scratchpad layout is incorrect - B tiles are being placed incorrectly
2. The MVIN operations have incorrect block lengths and strides
3. The output reading doesn't account for BF16 packing correctly
4. There are potential issues with the loop unrolling logic

Let me fix these issues:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized via Stationary Operand Caching.
void solution(void) {
  // Pre-format scale factor matrices to eliminate CPU-side staging in the hot loop
  static uint8_t A_scales_perf[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t B_scales_perf[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  // One-time pre-formatting before main loops start
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      
      // Only copy actual data, handle partial blocks correctly
      for (int i = 0; i < mrows; i++) {
        A_scales_perf[i0][g][i] = A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK + i];
      }
      // Pad with zeros for partial blocks if needed
      for (int i = mrows; i < BLK; i++) {
        A_scales_perf[i0][g][i] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      // Only copy actual data, handle partial blocks correctly
      for (int j = 0; j < ncols; j++) {
        B_scales_perf[j0][g][j] = B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK + j];
      }
      // Pad with zeros for partial blocks if needed
      for (int j = ncols; j < BLK; j++) {
        B_scales_perf[j0][g][j] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  // Hoist invariant Gemmini execution configuration outside all loops
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  // Swap loop order: outer loop over B column blocks (j0) to maximize weight reuse
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    int tiles_I = (BLK + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Round up to nearest tile count
    int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Round up to nearest tile count
    int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    
    // Ensure we don't exceed actual dimensions for this block
    int actual_tiles_I = (BLK + DIM - 1) / DIM;
    int actual_tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM;
    
    // Calculate proper scratchpad layout
    uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - actual_tiles_J * tiles_K * DIM;
    uint32_t a_base = 0;
    int SPAD_DEST = 0;  // Use beginning of accumulator

    // Flush to synchronize state
    gemmini_flush(0);

    // Load B (weight) scale factors once per column block
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_perf[j0][0][0], B_S_BYTES, 1);

    // Load B tiles into the upper half of the scratchpad (remains stationary for all i0)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // B rows: stride N
    const elem_t *B_col_base = (const elem_t*)B_in + (j0 * BLK);
    for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < actual_tiles_J; j++) {
        const elem_t *B_tile_ptr = B_col_base + (k * DIM * MATMUL_N) + (j * DIM);
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)B_tile_ptr,
                               b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
      }
    }

    // Inner loop over A row blocks (i0)
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int pad_i = (actual_tiles_I * DIM) - mrows;
      int pad_j = (actual_tiles_J * DIM) - ncols;
      int pad_k = 0;

      // Load dynamic A scale factors
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_perf[i0][0][0], A_S_BYTES, 0);

      // Load dynamic A tiles into the lower half of the scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t)); // A rows: stride K
      const elem_t *A_row_base = (const elem_t*)A_in + (i0 * BLK * MATMUL_K);
      for (int i = 0; i < actual_tiles_I; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          const elem_t *A_tile_ptr = A_row_base + (i * DIM * MATMUL_K) + (k * DIM);
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)A_tile_ptr,
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      gemmini_config_st(REAL_N * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, actual_tiles_I, actual_tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      
      // Perform computation utilizing the stationary B tiles and newly loaded A tiles
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(actual_tiles_I, actual_tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, pad_k, 
                           a_base, b_base, 0, SPAD_DEST, 
                           false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain results to DRAM - account for BF16 packing (4 per uint64)
      int bf16_per_row = (ncols + 1) / 2 * 2;  // Round up to even for pairing
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][j0 * BLK], 
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * bf16_per_row, ncols);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
